select * from d360.STG_RLS_RefRowLevelSecurity order by file_name

select * from d360.HASH_LOG_TBL

CREATE PROCEDURE d360.SP_hash_log_RLS
AS
BEGIN

with hashlogs_src as (
select file_name
,CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8)) AS Date
,GETDATE() AS INSERT_DTTM
,'COUNT' AS METRICS
,USERID AS SOURCE
from d360.STG_RLS_RefRowLevelSecurity
WHERE H = 'F'
 )

,  hashlogs_tgt as (
select file_name
,CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8)) AS Date
,GETDATE() AS INSERT_DTTM
,'COUNT' AS METRICS
,count(1) AS TARGET
from d360.STG_RLS_RefRowLevelSecurity
WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME )

, hashlogs_final as (
select convert(varchar(50),a.file_name) file_name, a.Date, convert(date,a.INSERT_DTTM) INSERT_DTTM, a.METRICS, convert(int,a.SOURCE) SOURCE,convert(int,B.TARGET) TARGET FROM hashlogs_src A
JOIN hashlogs_tgt B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_Hashlogs_final from hashlogs_final;

----UPDATE A
UPDATE A SET
A.Source = B.Source
,A.Target = B.Target
,A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
FROM d360.HASH_LOG_TBL A
JOIN #TEMP_Hashlogs_final B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME

----INSERT
INSERT INTO d360.HASH_LOG_TBL
SELECT * FROM #TEMP_Hashlogs_final A WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM d360.HASH_LOG_TBL B
        WHERE A.file_name = B.file_name)

END



---------------------------

select * from d360.HASH_LOG_TBL where file_name like '%RLS%'
--update d360.HASH_LOG_TBL set source = 99, target = 99 where file_name like '%RLS%'



MERGE d360.HASH_LOG_TBL AS Target
USING hashlogs_final AS Source
ON Source.file_name = Target.file_name
    
-- For Inserts
WHEN NOT MATCHED BY Target THEN
    INSERT (file_name,Date, INSERT_DTTM,METRICS, SOURCE, TARGET) 
    VALUES (Source.file_name,Source.Date, Source.INSERT_DTTM, Source.METRICS, Source.SOURCE, Source.TARGET)
    
-- For Updates
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
    Target.SOURCE	= Source.SOURCE,
    Target.TARGET	= Source.TARGET,
    Target.INSERT_DTTM = Source.INSERT_DTTM;
